post.description: Soft-delete a spool by setting archived_at.

put.description:
Replace all K-profiles for a spool (batch save).

A caller limited to some printers (#1727) replaces only theirs: the
profiles of printers it cannot see -- which its form never showed, a new
spool's from its product's profile default (#1326) among them -- stay.

schema.title: Response Replace K Profiles Api V1 Inventory Spools  Spool Id  K Profiles Put

put.description:
Replace all per-printer-model preset overrides for a spool.

Replace rather than merge, matching the K-profile endpoint next door: the
spool form always holds the complete set, and an empty list is how the
user clears every override back to the spool's own preset.

schema.title: Response Replace Filament Presets Api V1 Inventory Spools  Spool Id  Filament Presets Put

put.description:
Replace a spool's supplier assignments (#2988, batch save).

Same replace-all shape as the k-profiles endpoint. At most one assignment
may be the purchase source — the record of where this concrete spool was
actually bought; the rest read as alternative sources.

schema.title: Response Replace Spool Suppliers Api V1 Inventory Spools  Spool Id  Suppliers Put

schema.title: Response List Suppliers Api V1 Inventory Suppliers Get

SpoolFilamentPresetBase.title: SpoolFilamentPresetBase
SpoolFilamentPresetBase.description:
One per-printer-model slicer preset override for a spool.

``nozzle_diameter`` defaults to "" meaning "any nozzle of this model". The
spool form always sends a concrete size; the empty form is for API clients
that want one value to cover a model. Lengths match the columns, which are wider than
``Spool.slicer_filament`` so a preset id that fits the Spoolman write
schema cannot truncate on the way in.

SpoolSupplierLinkInput.title: SpoolSupplierLinkInput
SpoolSupplierLinkInput.description: One spool-to-supplier assignment as written by the spool dialog.

filament_catalog_writes_meta.note: FILAMENTS_CREATE and FILAMENTS_UPDATE are absent from _APIKEY_SCOPE_BY_PERMISSION and listed in _APIKEY_DENIED_PERMISSIONS: no API key can write the filament catalog, so such a write works only while Bambuddy's auth is off (prod: auth_enabled false, measured 2026-11-17 in rfid-routes.json).

spool_update_partial.note: PATCH /inventory/spools/{id} applies model_dump(exclude_unset=True): only the fields sent change. A sent weight_used locks the weight unless weight_locked is sent too; a sent last_dried_at clears last_dried_temp and last_dried_hours.

replace_all_lists.note: PUT k-profiles, filament-presets and suppliers each replace the spool's whole list; an empty list clears it. suppliers refuses a duplicate supplier or two purchase sources (400) and an unknown supplier (404).

duplicate_name_409.note: POST and PATCH of a supplier or a location answer 409 for a name another row has.

catalog_update_full.note: PUT /inventory/catalog/{id} takes name and weight (both required, weight an integer) and sets both.

missing_404.note: Each write on an id answers 404 when the row is missing (spool, supplier, location, catalog entry, filament).

measured_2026-11-18.method: GET only, no key, no body, https://bambuddy.internal.nullreference.io
